projects.title: RAG Pipeline: Hand-Rolled Retrieval, Validated Against LangChain at Scale
projects.meta: Python · LangChain · BM25 + dense hybrid · pgvector · Ollama · github.com/Deepak589/RAG_pipeline
bullets: Built a hand-rolled hybrid retriever from scratch over 4 iterative stages: BM25 plus a dense bi-encoder, RRF fusion, cross-encoder reranking. Reached 0.833 recall@5 and 0.672 MRR on a 55-question labeled golden set before adopting any framework.

Rebuilt the same retriever on LangChain using the identical corpus and labels, with the framework as the only changed variable. Caught a silent 0.06-recall regression from LangChain's default BM25 tokenizer and fixed it to 0.854 recall@5, so both implementations matched before scaling up.

Scaled the corpus ~100x, from 7 to ~740 documents and ~3.5GB across arXiv, SEC filings, Wikipedia and scanned PDFs, using a resumable ingestion pipeline that routes by file type into a pgvector-backed dense store.

projects.title: Food Image-to-Recipe Retrieval: Multimodal Deep Learning
projects.meta: PyTorch · CLIP ViT-B/32 · DistilBERT · FAISS · InfoNCE · MSc ML course final project · github.com/Deepak589/ML_Final_project
bullets: Built an image-to-recipe retrieval system over a 3,000-recipe database, reaching 61% Recall@10 at a median rank of 6, by encoding images and recipe text into CLIP's shared 512-d space and searching with FAISS. Measured both directions, not just the flattering one: recipe-to-image holds at 55% Recall@10.
Raised Recall@10 from 41.9% to 61.0% by ablating the blend weight between full recipe text and ingredient-only embeddings across four values, then selecting on measured Recall@K rather than by feel.

Built a second, trained dual-encoder variant (frozen CLIP images, DistilBERT recipe text, symmetric InfoNCE) behind OmegaConf configs with three switchable fusion modes and 58 tests, caching CLIP features for all 13,582 images to cut training time ~10x.

projects.title: RA Nutrition & Lifestyle App: Shipped Full-Stack Product
projects.meta: React · FastAPI · PostgreSQL · Docker · live at ra-project-indol.vercel.app · github.com/Deepak589/RA_project
bullets: Deployed a live full-stack health app as two tiers: a React/Vite/Tailwind frontend on Vercel, and a FastAPI + PostgreSQL backend (4 logical schemas) running as a Docker container on Render, with JWT auth and token refresh.

projects.title: CloudNotes: Kubernetes & AWS Deployment Platform
projects.meta: AWS EC2 + RDS · K3s · GitHub Actions · Traefik · MSc cloud computing, team of 3 · github.com/Deepak589/cloudnotes
bullets: Owned the Kubernetes layer on a 3-person team. Wrote the Deployment with CPU and memory requests and limits, a ClusterIP Service, a Traefik Ingress, readiness and liveness probes, and an HPA that scales 2 to 5 replicas at 60% CPU. Credentials come from Kubernetes Secrets, never from the image.

Built the GitHub Actions pipeline that replaced the team's manual deploys: Docker buildx multi-architecture build (linux/amd64 and linux/arm64), push to Docker Hub, SSH to EC2, then kubectl set image. Every release is gated on kubectl rollout status, so rollouts finish with no downtime.
Provisioned the AWS environment: EC2 t3.medium, Elastic IP, VPC, security groups and RDS MySQL. Costed managed Kubernetes against K3s and picked K3s for a single-node workload at about $86/month.
